libkscreen.description: Source for kscreen-doctor and display configuration models/backends. Inspect doctor/ and src/ to confirm JSON output, output names, mode IDs/names, rotation, VRR, brightness, and CLI argument handling. Check the installed version before relying on default-branch behavior.

libplasma.description: Source for PlasmoidItem, the Plasmoid attached object, applet configuration, Plasma Components/Extras, and plasma_install_package. Use to confirm popup, tooltip, QML property ownership, and package installation behavior for Plasma 6.

plasma5support.description: Source for Plasma5Support.DataSource and the executable data engine used by main.qml. Use to confirm asynchronous command execution, result fields, source connection/disconnection, and command lifecycle.

plasma-workspace.description: Source for plasmashell and the desktop/panel hosts. Use for widget instance lifecycle, containment behavior, shell reloads, and configuration UI behavior outside libplasma.

kirigami.description: Source for org.kde.kirigami, including Units, Theme, icons, and layout helpers used by the applet. Use to confirm sizing, theme inheritance, and QML component behavior.

qtdeclarative.description: Qt source mirror for QML, QtQuick, QtQuick.Controls, and QtQuick.Layouts. Use to confirm bindings, Bound component behavior, delegates, JavaScript integration, and Qt.callLater. The default branch is development code; compare against the installed Qt 6 version.

kconfig.description: Source for KConfig and KConfigXT. Use with libplasma to confirm main.xml defaults, configuration groups, filenames, and per-instance persistence semantics.

kpackage.description: Source for KPackage and kpackagetool6. Use to confirm package metadata, installation, upgrade, removal, and package structure handling.

ki18n.description: Source for KDE localization and QML i18n integration. Use to confirm user-visible string translation, substitutions, and plural handling.

plasma-sdk.description: Source for plasmoidviewer, the project's manual verification tool. Use to confirm viewer options and how its applet hosting differs from plasmashell.

extra-cmake-modules.description: Source for ECM, KDEInstallDirs, and KDECMakeSettings used by CMakeLists.txt. Use to confirm KDE installation paths and CMake configuration behavior.
